heading: Mandatory application of sections 5102 and 5124
lead: Notwithstanding section 5125 of this title, sections 5102 and 5124 of this title shall apply to—

tree.text: all lands held in trust by the United States for Indians, and
all lands owned by Indians that are subject to a restriction imposed by the United States on alienation of the rights of the Indians in the lands.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 478–1 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
